name: The Energy Investigation
tip: Energy is transferred between stores; it is not created or destroyed.

questions.q: What type of energy is stored in a stretched spring?
questions.why: A stretched or compressed spring stores elastic potential energy.

questions.q: Which material is usually a good electrical conductor?
questions.why: Copper is a metal and allows electric charge to flow easily.

questions.q: What happens to a light ray when it reflects?
questions.why: Reflection is when light bounces off a surface.
